n. 拥护, 支持, 鼓吹, 辩护, 辩护术
[法] 辩护, 拥护, 提倡

advocacy journalism.translation: (阐明观点或原因的)偏袒性(或倾向性)新闻报道；鼓吹性新闻；提倡某一事业(或表明某一观点)的报刊

advocate.definition:
n. a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea
n. a lawyer who pleads cases in court
advocate.translation:
n. 提倡者, 拥护者
vt. 主张, 提倡

advocated.definition:
v push for something
v speak, plead, or argue in favor of
advocated.translation:
vt. 提倡, 主张, 拥护
n. 提倡者；支持者；律师

advocater.translation:
vt. 提倡；拥护；主张；鼓吹；为…辩护：
n. 提倡者，倡导者；拥护者；鼓吹者(of)；辩护者，辩护士

advocates.definition:
n a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea
n a lawyer who pleads cases in court
v push for something
v speak, plead, or argue in favor of
advocates.translation:
n. （辩护）律师( advocate的名词复数 ); 提倡者; 辩护律师; [A-]基督
v. 提倡( advocate的第三人称单数 ); 拥护; 鼓吹; 为…辩护

advocati.translation: [法] 赞助人, 辩护人, 说话者

advocating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Advocate
advocating.translation:
拥护
提倡
辩护（advocate的现在分词）

advocation.definition:
n. The act of advocating or pleading; plea; advocacy.
n. Advowson.
n. The process of removing a cause from an inferior court
   to the supreme court.

advocator.definition: n a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea
advocator.translation: n. 拥护者, 提倡者

advocatory.definition: a. Of or pertaining to an advocate.
advocatory.translation: a. 拥护者的, 有关拥护者的

advowee.definition: n. One who has an advowson.
advowee.translation: n. 【英国法律】有权推荐受俸牧师的人

advowson.definition: n the right in English law of presenting a nominee to a vacant ecclesiastical benefice
advowson.translation: n. (英国法律)受俸牧师推荐权

advowsons.definition:
plural of advowson
n the right in English law of presenting a nominee to a vacant ecclesiastical benefice
advowsons.translation: (advowson 的复数) n.(英国法律)受俸牧师推荐权

advt.translation: abbr. advertisement 广告; advertising 广告; advertise 做广告; advertiser 登广告者

advts.translation: (advt 的复数) abbr. advertisement 广告; advertising 广告; advertise 做广告; advertiser 登广告者
